decisions.statement: A finding informs a decision rather than demanding a decision.
A finding is keyed only by its file stem.
A finding whose claim is no longer true is done.
A finding whose evidence has gone false is mended rather than done.
A finding carried into a domain intent or an initiative intent is done.
A finding written into the book section with its subject is done.
A finding ruled not worth acting on is done.
An observation that comes up again is filed as a new finding rather than the old finding restored.
A file or property close to its length limit is no finding.

definition: something noticed about a domain, written down before anyone judges what it means
